body: Repair the live Doré Design editor page activation defect so New Westside · Watchtower Fold is visibly active and clickable, then verify against the live 4310 runtime.

argv: mkdir -p ~/.dore/design-runtime && git show origin/main:dore-design/app.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app.py && git show origin/main:dore-design/app_workspace.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_workspace.py && git show origin/main:dore-design/app_product.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_product.py
pkill -f 'app_product.py' || true; sleep 1; cd ~/.dore/design-runtime && nohup python3 app_product.py > ~/.dore/design/editor.log 2>&1 &

sleep 2; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
h=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/health',timeout=5).read().decode())
assert h.get('page_activation_fix') is True,h
html=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4310/',timeout=5).read().decode()
assert 'pointer-events:auto!important' in html
assert

in html
w=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/workspace',timeout=5).read().decode())
p=next((x for x in w.get('pages',[]) if x.get('id')=='new-westside-watchtower-fold'),None)
assert p and p.get('name')=='New Westside · Watchtower Fold'
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'code':'WATCHTOWER_EDITOR_CLICK_FIX_LIVE','revision':w.get('revision'),'page_id':p['id'],'page_name':p['name'],'health':h},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
